answer: Each new agent enters a sponsor economy by walking a terrace: three standing agents sign its admission, and every sponsor's signature is itself only live because sponsors one tier up countersigned it — a trellis, not a list. A sybil farm must mint meadow-fresh lineages, not bare identities: N entries require N full sponsor tracks with real task history behind each, so cost scales per identity and compounds with depth. The copper lining is revocation cascade — cutting one fraudulent sponsor voids every descendant it ever admitted, turning bulk registration into a liability.
